name: token-rate
description: Real-time token rate & usage stats for ZCode sessions (MCP tool + /token-rate command + per-turn hook line); output language follows the ZCode UI language, detailed line/window configurable in plugin settings. ZCode 会话 token 速率与用量实时统计，输出语言跟随 ZCode 界面语言，详细行/窗口可在插件设置中配置。

inject_line.title: 每轮注入速率行 / Inject per-turn rate line
inject_line.description: 关闭后 hook 不再向会话注入 [token-rate] 行（MCP 工具与 /token-rate 命令不受影响）。/ When off, the hook stops injecting the [token-rate] line (MCP tool and /token-rate command are unaffected).

detailed_line.title: 详细速率行 / Detailed rate line
detailed_line.description: 开 = 完整统计（速率/吞吐/累计/时长）；关 = 极简一行（默认）。/ On = full stats (rate/throughput/totals/duration); off = minimal one-liner (default).

window_minutes.title: 吞吐窗口（分钟）/ Throughput window (minutes)
window_minutes.description: 吞吐统计的滑动窗口大小，默认 10。/ Sliding window size for throughput stats, default 10.

language.title: 输出语言 / Output language
language.description: auto = 跟随 ZCode 界面语言（默认）；zh / en = 强制中文 / 英文。/ auto = follow the ZCode UI language (default); zh / en = force Chinese / English.
